The BSc (Hons) Global Business programme will allow the student to discover the concepts, theories and techniques used across a range of business areas, enabling them to become a ‘future ready’ graduate with the knowledge, skills and competence needed to land a professional business career.

Student will relate this knowledge to practical business problems, demonstrating how they are affected by individuals, organisations as well as markets and societies, and discover the relationships that concern the wider business environment and their importance within a regional, national, European and global context.

The programme offers a range of modules which focus on various areas within global business, such as accounting and finance, marketing, human resource management, economics, leadership and sustainability reporting. These modules are designed to provide students with a deeper understanding of the topics related to global business and will also help them to develop their interpersonal and transferable skills, enabling them to work and communicate effectively in a range of business environments.

This MSc Health Promotion and Public Health programme will give students the necessary key skills and experience needed to successfully flourish within a public health/healthcare related role.

On this programme students will learn about the theories and philosophies that underpin health and wellbeing, and explore the role and impact of local, national, and international public health programmes. Students will explore and apply key concepts in epidemiology, health economics, and other forms of evidence for the promotion and improvement of the health and wellbeing of selected populations.

Students will also benefit from a work-based learning component, where they will link theory to practice whilst on placement at a health promotion/public health/health improvement organisation.

  • Gain the necessary knowledge and skills to effectively identify and ethically address health inequalities.
  • Propose solutions to the ethical, legal, leadership and management issues in public health.
  • Learn about and assess the impact of policy on health and wellbeing and health inequalities.
  • Develop information literacy skills, digital capabilities and reflective practice to address current public health issues.

This programme is ideal for anyone interested in working in the population health and health promotion field, whether this is within the NHS, community organisations, government or other related agencies.
